title: Labbench AML Scratchpad: quant & eval todo
content:
Labbench scratchpad — quick log (notes to self)

2026-03-12 morning brain dump
- Goal: get a stable baseline for Llama2-13B quantized (q4f16 and q5_0) on new runtime kernels. Measure latency, p50/p95, token cost, and quality on small eval sets.
- Constraints: single V100-like devbox (16GB), limited to 2 concurrent configs today. Use cached prefixes where possible.

Recent runs (summary):
- 2026-03-11 22:10 | model: llama2-13b-q4f16 | batch 1 seq 256 | p50=120ms p95=270ms | notes: unstable kv eviction, occasional +50ms spikes when GC runs
- 2026-03-11 23:05 | model: llama2-13b-q5_0 | batch 4 seq 128 | p50=180ms p95=380ms | notes: better mem but small perplexity bump on SST-like prompts

Quick TODO (priority):
1) Re-run q4f16 with --kv-cache-size=2G and record p95 with 500 requests (scripts/repro/run_quant_eval.sh) — high priority (blocks A/B compare)
2) Create a minimal prompt-set (50 examples) focusing on factual QA + instruction-following to compare quality delta (write prompt templates below)
3) Try kernel flag --prefer-fp16-kernels to see if latency improves for q5_0 (low-risk)
4) Capture heap profiles during a 30-min run (pprof) and push to s3 for offline analysis
5) Add a tiny canary that routes 5% traffic to q5_0 on staging (product asks for safety check)

Command snippets (copy/paste):
- ./scripts/run_quant_eval.sh --model /mnt/models/llama2-13b-q4f16 --batch 1 --seq 256 --requests 500 --out logs/q4f16/run-20260312.json
- python tools/compare_eval.py --gold data/eval_small.jsonl --pred logs/q4f16/preds.jsonl --metrics rouge,exact_match,accuracy
- perf record -F 99 -g -- ./bin/infer --model-path /mnt/models/llama2-13b-q4f16 --batch 1 --seq 256

Prompt templates (for the 50-example quickset):
- Instruction style: "You are a helpful technical assistant. Answer concisely.
Q: {{question}}
A:"
- Factual QA: short Wikipedia-style questions, expect 1-2 sentence answers.
- Multi-turn test case: 3-turn dialogue, check pronoun resolution
- System directive fuzz: add one safety edge-case per prompt

Observations / hypotheses so far:
- q4f16 gives good latency but sometimes hallucination rate (small) increases on multi-hop questions. Hypothesis: quantization flips low-magnitude weights used in attention head gating.
- p95 spikes coincide with small GC events inside the runtime (observed via /proc/smaps + kernel logs). Possibly memory fragmentation when KV cache resizes.
- Tokenization mismatch: some inputs with emojis cause token count to spike (detokenization bug?) — need to run tokenizer sanity check.

Experiment log (to expand later):
- run-id: q4f16-20260311-2210
  model_variant: q4f16
  hw: devbox-v100-16GB
  batch: 1 seq:256
  p50:120ms p95:270ms
  notes: kv-evict observed, tokenization weirdness on 3 samples

Failure modes to watch:
- OOM: reduce batch to 1, reduce seq to 128 if OOM seen
- Slow GC loops: capture heap and check for small allocations from Python side
- Repro diffs: fix random seeds for dataset and model (SEED=42 everywhere)

Open questions / decisions:
- If q5_0 consistently shows +3% accuracy but +40% latency, is it worth offering as a fallback for cost-insensitive customers? Tentative: yes for dedicated capacity only.
- Should we add a per-request cache key that includes prompt template version? That will let us invalidate cached prefixes when prompt templates change.

Notes to self (short misc):
- follow up with infra: ask about limit on mmap growth on staging nodes (might explain p95 spikes) (ticket: INFRA-778)
- pair with Nora for kernel flag test (she has the perf scripts)
- write a short one-pager explaining quant tradeoffs for docs (2-3 bullets, link to eval results)

Scratch area (raw outputs copied):
- sample prompt: "You are a concise assistant. Q: Who wrote 'The Left Hand of Darkness'? A:" -> model returns 'Ursula K. Le Guin' (good)
- sample failure: "Summarize: [long text with emojis]" -> tokenized length 3x expected, investigate tokenization module v1.2.3

Housekeeping entries:
- planned: archive logs to s3 under s3://redwood-logs/samira/quant/2026-03-12/ after runs complete
- blockers: node with older driver version (NVIDIA 510) — schedule update with infra next week

End of scratchpad (short actionable items at top).

Will expand after reruns tonight.

-- Samira
